name: Work IQ APIs
desc: The API set for reading and acting on Microsoft 365 work data.
desc_zh: 一套用来读取和操作 Microsoft 365 工作数据的 API。
solves: A plain Graph call returns everything and means nothing. Work IQ returns what matters for the task, so an agent gets context and permissions in one place.
solves_zh: 一次普通 Graph 调用把东西全给你，却不告诉你哪条要紧。Work IQ 只返回与任务相关的那部分，让 Agent 一次拿到上下文和权限。
best_for: You are building an enterprise agent that has to respect existing permissions.
best_for_zh: 你在做一个必须遵守现有权限边界的企业 Agent。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — Microsoft Copilot Blog, https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/blog/2026/06）。 Public preview on GitHub from 2026-06-02; general availability 2026-06-16. The same intelligence layer also powers Copilot, Autopilot and Agent 365. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/blog/2026/06/02/announcing-the-new-work-iq-apis/
